author: kevaundray
content:
Ah yes I agree; my point was then that we need at least N(safety_decay=10) blocks due to the WSP and the CL block retention window needs to be at least that big.

But using a safety decay of 100 with the justification that we should use it for long periods of non-finality doesn't make sense to me because they are not linked

author: kevaundray
content: I was also saying that with a safety decay of 100, we get 4-5 months worth of blocks, but if we re-derive it faithfully, it would be 2-2.5 months due to 8061
